reason: Main SDK and Godot environment migrated and validated; inaccessible scratch remnants retained and shared external toolchains left at existing locations.
physical_storage_note: Relocation reduces repository footprint. C: source and D: destination are different volumes; no whole-machine free-space saving is claimed. Previously compressed files may occupy more space at the destination.
recovery: Use manifest source/destination mapping. To restore, copy destination files back without overwriting user files, verify critical hashes, and set UNICORE_OCCT_SDK_ROOT / UNICORE_GODOT_ENV_ROOT to restored paths. Original worker/build manifest are retained under SDK/OCCT/migration-original-build.
limitations: Inaccessible scratch directories remain; their sizes are unknown. Report totals cover accessible regular files only.
Existing shared D:/msys64 and C:/Qt toolchains remain in place; external SDK build still requires them.
SDK package archives remain with their locked SDK-local names for offline reconstruction.
Project .godot cache remains local because Godot imports use the project directory; editor scan verified it.
Other historical HPC benchmark directories remain in .tools; historical reports and receipts are preserved.
Legacy SCons build still uses its established local intermediate paths; active Godot472 builder uses external cache.
